mutations.label: agents: a definition requests a capability class, not a pinned id
mutations.only: ^(?:every catalogue entry still matches the source it mutates, exactly once|every shipped agent definition names a capability class)$

mutations.label: ADR-098 T2: the synthesis agent mirrors the canonical blocking criteria
mutations.from: 4. It has a minimal in-scope remedy.
mutations.only: ^the blocking criteria have one definition and every mirror is its text$

mutations.label: ADR-098 T2: an agent file does not restate the leaf contract
mutations.from: You reduce several independent reviews to one verdict.
mutations.to: You reduce several independent reviews to one verdict. You are a leaf: you do not spawn further agents.
mutations.only: ^no agent file restates the leaf contract the SubagentStart hook gives$
